headings.usage: Use for all main headers (H1, H2, H3). Never use Inter or Roboto for headings.

numbers_and_amounts.usage: CRITICAL: Use for all financial amounts, balances, and dates to provide a technical, precise numeric personality.

typography.notes: Maintain a confident, left-aligned hierarchy. Avoid generic center alignment for layout containers.

layout_and_spacing.padding: Generous padding inside sections (p-6, p-8). Keep gaps tight (gap-4, gap-6) in tabular structures to maximize data density.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-sm (2px) or rounded-none for a sharp, architectural, non-bubbly feel.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Left-align all paragraphs, labels, and tabular data. Align financial amounts to the right in table cells for decimal alignment.

components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-sm), high contrast. Primary: bg-[#0055FF] text-white. Secondary: bg-white border border-zinc-200 text-zinc-950 hover:bg-zinc-50.
components.cards_and_panels: Cardless or flat cards with 1px border-zinc-200, no drop shadows. Background: bg-white.
components.lists_and_tables: Heavy use of border-b (border-zinc-200) for lists instead of wrapping every item in a card. Hover states on rows (hover:bg-zinc-50).
components.modals: Backdrop blur (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/70) with a sharp, 1px bordered modal container.
components.charts: Recharts or Shadcn Charts. Minimalist lines or bars using the accent color (#0055FF), without heavy grid lines.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Crisp transitions. hover:bg-zinc-50 for lists. hover:-translate-y-[1px] for buttons.
motion_and_interactions.feedback: Use sonner for clean, crisp toast notifications.
motion_and_interactions.accessibility: Ensure all interactive states have distinct contrast.

image_urls.description: Abstract clean architectural geometry white, use as subtle background for login/register layout.
Grayscale portrait for friend/group member avatar.

testing_requirements.data_testid: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install custom fonts (Cabinet Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono) via Google Fonts or standard CSS imports in index.css.
Apply Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) strictly. Strictly avoid all purple/violet shades. Stick to Zinc neutrals and the single strong Cobalt Blue accent (#0055FF).
Use data-centric, tabular styling for expense lists. Avoid generic 'card grids' for expenses. Use border-b lists to maximize clarity and 'developer-portfolio-quality' minimalism.
Format all money values and dates using the JetBrains Mono font for a precise, technical feel.
Ensure the entire UI feels 'tasteful, modern, restrained, professional'. The personality comes from layout structure, typography contrast, and numeric formatting, not from colorful gradients.
Do NOT use HTML-based components for advanced user interactions; utilize Shadcn UI components heavily customized with these sharp, border-heavy styling rules.
